# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 1.x     | :white_check_mark: |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

We take the security of the Data Annotation Tool seriously. If you discover a security vulnerability, please do NOT create a public GitHub issue.

Instead, please send a report to the maintainers or open a private security advisory on GitHub.

### When reporting, please include:
- A description of the vulnerability and its potential impact.
- Clear steps or a minimal proof-of-concept to reproduce the behavior.
- Any suggested fixes or mitigations.

We will acknowledge your report within 48 hours and provide updates as the fix is developed and published.
